papers.title: Official sample · A-Level Statistics and Mechanics 03

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Scale histogram bars for unequal class widths.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Relate bar area to frequency and transfer both horizontal and vertical scales from the supplied reference class.
provenance.year_basis: Histogram frequency density and unequal class widths are within AS scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Compare grouped-data summaries with a normal sunshine model.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Estimate grouped-data mean and spread, compare consistency, estimate a data-based upper count and compare it with the normal-model prediction.
provenance.year_basis: The normal-model comparison is additional A level content; the linked mean/spread and count parts remain grouped because the final comparison needs their computed results.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Assess an extrapolated regression prediction.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Compare the proposed input with the observed temperature range.
provenance.year_basis: Regression interpretation and extrapolation are within AS scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Interpret the product moment correlation coefficient.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Identify the aspect of linear association measured by the supplied coefficient.
provenance.year_basis: Interpreting a correlation coefficient is the additional A level extension of the hypothesis-testing point.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Test a population correlation.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: State population-coefficient hypotheses, choose the one-tailed critical value and interpret the sample coefficient at the stated level.
provenance.year_basis: Hypothesis testing for correlation coefficients is additional A level content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Use the large data set to identify a plausible location.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use geographical and seasonal knowledge of the prescribed large data set to justify a location.
provenance.year_basis: Familiarity with locations and variables in the large data set is within AS scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Combine normal measurement and binomial batch models.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Infer a normal mean from a supplied percentile, find the acceptable-length probability and reuse its complement in a binomial count.
provenance.year_basis: The linked normal-distribution calculation is additional A level content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Test a normal population mean.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use the sampling distribution of the mean with known standard deviation, apply a one-tailed significance test and state the contextual conclusion.
provenance.year_basis: Testing the mean of a normal distribution is additional A level content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Find a conditional probability involving complements.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use the union-complement probability as a numerator and the conditioning complement as a denominator.
provenance.year_basis: Conditional probability is additional A level content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Check whether two events are independent.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Compare the supplied intersection probability with the product of the two marginal probabilities.
provenance.year_basis: Independence of events is within AS scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Complete a three-event probability diagram.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Combine independence and mutual exclusivity to assign all Venn regions, then sum the regions outside the required union.
provenance.year_basis: Venn diagrams, independence, mutual exclusivity and complements are within AS scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Explain why destructive testing should use a sample.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Relate a census to the practical consequences of germinating the entire seed population.
provenance.year_basis: Population and sample reasoning is within AS scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Use a binomial model within another binomial model.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Find a tray success probability and use that probability in a second binomial distribution for the number of successful trays.
provenance.year_basis: Both stages use the AS binomial-distribution scope; their nested structure raises difficulty without adding Year 13 content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: State conditions for a normal approximation to a binomial model.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: State appropriate restrictions on the binomial parameters for a usable normal approximation.
provenance.year_basis: The normal approximation to the binomial is additional A level content under official Statistics 4.2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Approximate a binomial tail and evaluate a germination claim.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use the binomial mean and variance, apply a continuity correction and interpret the resulting tail probability as evidence about the claim.
provenance.year_basis: The normal approximation is additional A level content, although the underlying binomial hypothesis-testing point also contains AS material.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Find speed from a time-dependent vector acceleration.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Integrate both acceleration components, impose the initial velocity and calculate the magnitude of the velocity at the requested time.
provenance.year_basis: Calculus in two-dimensional kinematics extends the AS one-dimensional calculus scope.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Determine friction on an incline and assess rest afterwards.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Resolve normal and tangential forces during upward motion, determine the friction coefficient and compare limiting friction with the downhill component after stopping.
provenance.year_basis: Friction and resolving forces on an inclined plane are additional A level mechanics content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Find a boat’s constant vector acceleration.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use the change in each supplied velocity component over the stated elapsed time.
provenance.year_basis: Constant-acceleration motion in two dimensions extends AS one-dimensional kinematics.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Distinguish a boat’s north-east position from its direction of travel.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Construct vector displacement and velocity expressions, then impose equal positive components on the appropriate vector for each direction question.
provenance.year_basis: Vector constant-acceleration kinematics in two dimensions is additional A level content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Use moments for a loaded ladder in equilibrium.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Identify the force positions and use perpendicular distances in a moment balance about the foot.
provenance.year_basis: Moments and rigid-body equilibrium are additional A level mechanics content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Find the force range preventing ladder slip.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use vertical and horizontal equilibrium with both possible friction directions to obtain the admissible applied-force interval.
provenance.year_basis: Planar equilibrium with limiting friction is additional A level mechanics content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Explain how extra load at a ladder’s foot affects stability.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Connect the added downward load with the ground reaction and available friction while recognising its position in the moment balance.
provenance.year_basis: Frictional equilibrium of an extended body is additional A level mechanics content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Determine a projectile’s launch speed and later speed.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Resolve the initial velocity, combine horizontal and vertical displacement conditions, then recover both velocity components at the specified height.
provenance.year_basis: Projectile motion is additional A level mechanics content.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Suggest improvements to a projectile model.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Identify two physical assumptions in the stated free-flight model that could be made more realistic.
provenance.year_basis: Evaluating a projectile model is additional A level mechanics content.
